item.title: Leveraging Postman: My Journey as a QA Professional
item.description: In the world of software development, APIs are the backbone that connects different services and applications. As a QA professional, ensuring the reliability and functionality of these APIs has always been my top priority. My journey with Postman has been transformative, and I’d like to share how this tool has revolutionized my approach to API testing throughout the API lifecycle. The Beginning: Discovering Postman I first encountered Postman during a particularly challenging project.
